title: Expand a bounded-retry Agentic Recipe with explicit escalation
narrative: Fangore starts the CLI host with family `pass_through` and backend `mock`, and works with the `bounded_retry` recipe. Fangore needs retries that are visible: classify the failure, decide whether another attempt is allowed, apply backoff, and escalate when attempts are exhausted — not an invisible executor loop. Must compose with durable external-effect recovery from `fangore_tdr_crash_before_intent` and sibling TDR crash-window stories. He walks product steps (instantiate_recipe) and verifies completion from the structured observation expects on this scenario.
implementation: Agentic Recipe `bounded_retry` (`BoundedRetryTemplate`) builds attempt → classify → permit_retry → backoff with a terminal escalate node and a StopContract on the repeating attempt. Attempt payloads carry deliberate attempt context and an effect-reconciliation flag (RT-01..05).
validation: Harness `user_story` scenario `bounded_retry_recipe.yaml`: environment + graph + steps + complete expects.
